gbifID.description: Unique numeric identifier for each species occurrence record in the dataset.

datasetKey.description: Unique identifier for the dataset source.

occurrenceID.description: Unique iNaturalist observation URLs identifying individual species records.

kingdom.description: The kingdom is consistently recorded as Animalia for all species occurrences.

phylum.description: The phylum for all records is Arthropoda.

class.description: Taxonomic class of the recorded species, consistently identified as Insecta.

order.description: Lepidoptera order classification for all recorded species occurrences.

family.description: The family of the recorded species, consistently identified as Nymphalidae.

genus.description: Genus name for the species Idea leuconoe.

species.description: The scientific name of the recorded species.

infraspecificEpithet.description: Infraspecific epithet values for the species, primarily clara.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank of the recorded organism, specifically species or subspecies.

scientificName.description: Scientific name of the recorded species, including subspecies designations.

verbatimScientificName.description: Original taxonomic names recorded for the species, including subspecies designations.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: The column is entirely empty, containing no recorded authorship data for scientific names.

countryCode.description: Country code identifying the nation of species occurrence records.

locality.description: This column is entirely null and contains no recorded locality data.

stateProvince.description: Geographic state or province of species occurrence records.

occurrenceStatus.description: The occurrence status of the species, recorded as present.

individualCount.description: The individualCount field is entirely empty, containing no recorded values.

publishingOrgKey.description: Unique identifier for the publishing organization.

decimalLatitude.description: Decimal latitude coordinates of species occurrences, measured in degrees.

decimalLongitude.description: Decimal longitude coordinates in degrees, ranging from 97.44 to 138.14.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Coordinate uncertainty radius in meters for species occurrence records.

coordinatePrecision.description: The coordinate precision field is entirely empty, containing no recorded values.

elevation.description: Elevation data is entirely missing from the records.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation accuracy is entirely missing from all records.

depth.description: All values are missing, providing no depth information for the occurrence records.

depthAccuracy.description: This column is entirely empty, containing no recorded depth accuracy data.

eventDate.description: Event date and time of species observation, ranging from 1970 to 2026.

day.description: Day of the month for species occurrence records, ranging from 1 to 31.

month.description: Month of species occurrence, expressed as an integer from 1 to 12.

year.description: Integer year of species occurrence, ranging from 1970 to 2026.

taxonKey.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier for each taxonomic species in the occurrence records.

speciesKey.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier for the Idea leuconoe species.

basisOfRecord.description: The method of species observation recorded for each occurrence.

institutionCode.description: The institution code identifies the data source as iNaturalist.

collectionCode.description: The collection code for the recorded species observations.

catalogNumber.description: Unique numeric identifier for each leuconoe species occurrence record.

recordNumber.description: This column is entirely null and contains no data.

identifiedBy.description: Identifier of the person who determined the species identification.

dateIdentified.description: Date and time when the species observation was recorded.

license.description: The license column specifies Creative Commons usage permissions for the occurrence records.

rightsHolder.description: Identifier of the individual or organization holding the rights to the occurrence record.

recordedBy.description: Names of the individuals who recorded the species observations.

typeStatus.description: This column is entirely empty, containing no recorded data values.

establishmentMeans.description: All values are missing, indicating no establishment means data is available.

lastInterpreted.description: Timestamp of the last data interpretation for each occurrence record.

mediaType.description: Media type of the occurrence record, primarily still images.

issue.description: Semicolon-delimited flags indicating data quality issues such as coordinate rounding and taxonomic identification errors.

idea_leuconoe.description: 1000 Idea leuconoe occurrence records with taxonomic, spatial, and temporal metadata.

description: 1000 leuconoe species occurrence records spanning 2003 to 2026.
